answer: A visa on arrival is issued at the border, usually at a major airport, after landing, whereas an eVisa is an electronic visa applied for online before departure. [visa-categories#2] [visa-categories#3]

citations.snippet: Visa on arrival means the visa is issued at the border, usually at a major airport, after you land.
